'''Migov''' is the capital and cultural center of Nogoyev. It was the heart of Nogoyevian politics during the [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]] and later became the capital of the [[Tsardom of Nogoyev]].

The city is best known in the 1994-back port for the [[Battle of Migov]], a 1949-1952 urban battle that became one of the defining engagements of the war.

== War Damage ==

During the Battle of Migov, the city was reduced to ruins by artillery, airstrikes, mines, fortified buildings, and close urban combat. The battle made Migov a symbol of Nogoyevian endurance and independence.
